#Module webcodecs_codec

WebCodecs encoded chunks and AudioData (src/page/webcodecs_chunks.odin, native/js/runtime/web_webcodecs_codec.c). EncodedVideoChunk / EncodedAudioChunk are immutable coded samples; AudioData is decoded PCM with planar / interleaved copyTo. All the layouts and conversions are native.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/webcodecs_codec.widl.

#Types

#handle EncodedVideoChunk : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_EncodedVideoChunk).

#handle EncodedAudioChunk : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_EncodedAudioChunk).

#handle AudioData : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_AudioData).

#enum AudioSampleFormat : i32

The WebCodecs AudioSampleFormat enum, in the order webcodecs_chunks.odin's Audio_Sample_Format uses (format() returns -1 for a closed AudioData, which the engine maps to null).

membervalue
None0
U81
S162
S323
F324
U8_Planar5
S16_Planar6
S32_Planar7
F32_Planar8
